criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame rendered and the type sits in quiet. Interiors 2, 3 and 9 are the strongest, with raking window light. Frame 4 is a flat card against a featureless wall with labels floating off the page. The exterior coping is a featureless dark slab and the skyline extruded boxes. Frame 5's empty vial stands beside the tapes with a ghostly glass. Frame 6 reads as a cork cake in grey mud. Golden hour barely reaches the hero on 1 and 8, flies sit in sticker-like columns. Showstopper at 432 px: 2, 3, 9 pass, 1, 7, 8 nearly, 4, 5, 6 fail.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One hero in one material, one accent, one type system, the vial-state motif and the camera bookends work. Two worlds rather than one, undeclared value cuts at 4 to 5 and 8 to 9, and frame 4's flat void sits outside the rendered register.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces to a computed figure with a claim id. Frame 3's bar ratio is about 2.08 off solved_multiplier. Frame 5 scopes precision as not accuracy. Sources not re-fetched by this judge.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and what a reader can do are all there. No decision body or deadline exists to name, and eligibility is stated generally.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and frame 2 pays at once. Frame 5 interrupts the pointer-to-proof run, and frame 6's weak art undersells the turn.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register with good lines, honest without doom. Reads as a careful science explainer rather than distinctly Texan. Frame 4's dek is the flat line.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Subject and world fresh. A green accent two days running, and the opening and closing moves repeat no. 39.

one_sentence_fix: Put frame 4's page flat on the window-lit desk, give the exterior coping a textured sunlit top, and key the low sun onto the vial on 5 and 6 so the turn reads as a lit glass vial with downed flies.
